description: Get the schema for a segment type. CALL THIS FIRST before creating/updating segments. Returns required fields and their types for the specified segment type. Supported types: Flight, Lodging, CarRental, Train, Transfer, Ferry, EventTicket, Parking, Activity, Note, Poll. For commercial cruise reservations and sea/port days use cruise_* tools. Never substitute Activity, CruiseActivity or another segment type for a cruise day. Ordinary shore excursions remain valid Activity/CruiseActivity. If cruise tools are unavailable explain the limitation and ask for clarification. Cruise/CruiseDay generic writes require the dedicated cruise tools; their schemas and full reads remain available. Additional supported schemas: Cruise, CruiseDay, CruiseActivity.

segment_type.description: The segment type to get schema for (Flight, Lodging, CarRental, Train, Transfer, Ferry, EventTicket, Parking, Activity, Note, Poll); also Cruise, CruiseDay and CruiseActivity
